statements.statement: The district will build three FY27 budget scenarios: a level service budget, a level funded budget, and a prioritized necessary increase budget.
Health insurance costs for the coming year were being estimated/projected as a potentially large increase.

warnings.condition: given ongoing finance department staffing turnover and transitions
warnings.prediction: Budget season is expected to be much more chaotic and contentious than the recent special town meeting process
